name: contract-subject-counts
goal: Keep each callable case identity stable when a sibling callable gains a declared capability

evidence: Unit-wide capability comparison permits renaming a second callable case when only the first callable gains an authored example.

The existing compare case covered only a single entity. Strengthened that same case with two callables: a legitimate new first example cannot authorize a second case identity change. Two tests remain.

The existing comparison case fails because a first-callable capability addition authorizes changing second-callable case identity; immutable Harness proof retains the exact failure and unchanged two-test suite.

Compare case IDs separately by callable subject and compare only that callable signatures and authored examples, with declared shared states and props. The same two-case suite now rejects sibling identity changes.
